tools.name: list_bots
tools.description: List the bots this server can run: what each one does, its price per run, what a run returns, its input schema, and the names of its validate_ and start_ tools. Free and read-only.

tools.name: get_run
tools.description: Check a run started with a start_ tool and fetch its results. Needs the receipt_id AND the access_token that start_ returned: the token is the proof that the caller started the run, and without it nothing is returned. Status is awaiting_payment (the user has not paid yet), running, completed or fail

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: validate_inventory_reorder_inputs, start_inventory_reorder · Private data: get_run · Public sink: validate_inventory_reorder_inputs, start_inventory_reorder · Destructive: list_bots, validate_inventory_reorder_inputs, start_inventory_reorder, get_run.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: validate_inventory_reorder_inputs, start_inventory_reorder · Private data: get_run · Public sink: validate_inventory_reorder_inputs, start_inventory_reorder · Destructive: list_bots, validate_inventory_reorder_inputs, start_inventory_reorder, get_run

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
